en_us: Jars of souls for mob seeds, four elements and an altar that wakes supremium up.
es_es: Tarros de almas para semillas de mob, cuatro elementos y un altar que despierta al supremium.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: Grey veins
en_us.subtitle: Five percent of the vein, all of the fun.
text: [lead] Soulium hides in grey veins in the Nether.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulstone|Soulstone] fills big veins in netherrack.
[li] One block in [b|20] is [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ore|Soulium Ore]: [b|1] to [b|3] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Soulium Dust], more with Fortune.

es_es.title: Vetas grises
es_es.subtitle: El cinco por ciento de la veta, toda la diversión.
text: [lead] El soulium se esconde en vetas grises del Nether.
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:soulstone|Piedra de alma] llena vetas grandes en el netherrack.
[li] Uno de cada [b|20] bloques es [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ore|Mena de soulium]: [b|1] a [b|3] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Polvos de soulium], más con Fortuna.

en_us.title: Three trips through the furnace
en_us.subtitle: Soul glass is patient glass.
text: [lead] Soul dust takes three smelts of soulstone.
[li] Mined soulstone drops cobbled: smelt it into soulstone, then [item:mysticalagriculture:soulstone_smooth|Smooth Soulstone], then [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_dust|Soul Dust].
[li] Four soul dust around a glass block: [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_glass|Soul Glass].

es_es.title: Tres pasadas por el horno
es_es.subtitle: El cristal de alma es vidrio con paciencia.
text: [lead] El polvo de alma pide tres fundiciones de piedra de alma.

[li] Minada suelta la versión apedreada: fundila en piedra de alma, después en [item:mysticalagriculture:soulstone_smooth|Piedra de alma lisa] y al final en [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_dust|Polvo de alma].
[li] Cuatro polvos de alma alrededor de un cristal: [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_glass|Cristal de alma].

en_us.title: An ingot with a pulse
text: [lead] Soulium metal builds jars, daggers and machines.
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot] A [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot|Prosperity Ingot] and [b|2] soulium dust: a [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ingot|Soulium Ingot].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soulium_gemstone] With a prosperity gemstone: a [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_gemstone|Soulium Gemstone].

es_es.title: Un lingote con pulso
text: [lead] El metal de soulium arma tarros, dagas y máquinas.

[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot] Un [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot|Lingote de prosperidad] y [b|2] polvos de soulium: un [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ingot|Lingote de soulium].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soulium_gemstone] Con una gema de prosperidad: una [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_gemstone|Gema de soulium].

en_us.title: Jars for souls
en_us.subtitle: Label them. Trust us.
text: [lead] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jar] holds the souls of a single mob.
[li] Recipe: [b|3] soul glass and a soulium ingot.
[li] From [b|4] souls for a ghast to [b|12] for slimes.
[li] A mob seed eats [b|4] full jars.
{page}
[tip] A jar alone in the crafting grid comes out empty, in case you filled the wrong one.

es_es.title: Tarros para almas
es_es.subtitle: Etiquetalos. En serio.
text: [lead] Un [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarro de alma] guarda las almas de un solo mob.
[li] Receta: [b|3] cristales de alma y un lingote de soulium.
[li] De [b|4] almas para un ghast a [b|12] para los slimes.
[li] Una semilla de mob se come [b|4] tarros llenos.
{page}
[tip] Un tarro solo en la mesa sale vacío, por si lo llenaste con el mob equivocado.

en_us.title: The dagger that collects
en_us.subtitle: Every kill is a deposit.
text: [lead] Each kill with the [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dagger|Soulium Dagger] pours one soul into a jar you carry.
[li] Recipe: a golden sword, [b|2] soulium ingots and [b|2] soulium dust.
[li] The jar must hold that mob or nothing yet.
[li] Ten zombies fill a zombie jar.

es_es.title: La daga que cobra
es_es.subtitle: Cada muerte es un depósito.
text: [lead] Cada muerte con la [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dagger|Daga de soulium] vuelca un alma en un tarro que lleves.
[li] Receta: una espada de oro, [b|2] lingotes de soulium y [b|2] polvos de soulium.
[li] El tarro tiene que estar vacío o ser de ese mob.
[li] Diez zombis llenan un tarro de zombi.

en_us.title: A base for mob seeds
text: [lead] Every mob seed grows from a [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_seed_base|Soulium Seed Base].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base] Recipe: a [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Prosperity Seed Base] and [b|2] soulium dust.
[li] On the altar: [b|4] full jars and [b|4] essences of the mob's tier around it.

es_es.title: Una base para semillas de mob
text: [lead] Cada semilla de mob nace de una [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_seed_base|Base de semillas de soulium].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base] Receta: una [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Base de semillas de prosperidad] y [b|2] polvos de soulium.
[li] En el altar: [b|4] tarros llenos y [b|4] esencias del nivel del mob alrededor.

en_us.title: Attuned daggers
text: [lead] An attuned dagger takes [b|1.5] souls per kill of its kind.
[li] On the altar: the dagger, [b|2] soulium ingots, [b|2] soulium gemstones and [b|4] full jars.
[li:mysticalagriculture:passive_soulium_dagger] Pig, chicken, cow and sheep: [item:mysticalagriculture:passive_soulium_dagger|Passive Soulium Dagger].
[li:mysticalagriculture:hostile_soulium_dagger] Zombie, skeleton, creeper and spider: [item:mysticalagriculture:hostile_soulium_dagger|Hostile Soulium Dagger].

es_es.title: Dagas sintonizadas
text: [lead] Una daga sintonizada saca [b|1,5] almas por muerte de su tipo.
[li] En el altar: la daga, [b|2] lingotes y [b|2] gemas de soulium y [b|4] tarros llenos.
[li:mysticalagriculture:passive_soulium_dagger] Cerdo, pollo, vaca y oveja: [item:mysticalagriculture:passive_soulium_dagger|Daga de soulium pasiva].
[li:mysticalagriculture:hostile_soulium_dagger] Zombi, esqueleto, creeper y araña: [item:mysticalagriculture:hostile_soulium_dagger|Daga de soulium hostil].

en_us.title: A thirstier dagger
text: [tip] The Enchanter puts Soul Siphoner on a dagger.
[li] [b|8] soulium dust and [b|64] experience essence per level.
[li] Each level adds [b|10%] to every soul collected.

es_es.title: Una daga con más sed
text: [tip] El Encantador le pone Sifón de almas a una daga.
[li] [b|8] polvos de soulium y [b|64] esencias de experiencia por nivel.
[li] Cada nivel suma [b|10%] a cada alma que junta.

en_us.title: Souls from leftovers
en_us.subtitle: Rotten flesh finally has a job.
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_extractor|Soul Extractor] turns mob drops into souls.
[li] Recipe: iron, [b|2] soulium ingots, [b|2] daggers and a machine frame.
[li] Rotten flesh is half a zombie soul; a zombie head, three.
[li] It fills the jar inside and burns solid fuel.

es_es.title: Almas de las sobras
es_es.subtitle: La carne podrida por fin tiene laburo.
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_extractor|Extractora de almas] vuelve almas los drops de los mobs.
[li] Receta: hierro, [b|2] lingotes de soulium, [b|2] dagas y un marco de máquina.
[li] La carne podrida vale media alma de zombi; una cabeza de zombi, tres.
[li] Llena el tarro que tenga adentro y quema combustible sólido.

en_us.title: Soulium, planted
text: [lead] [b|8] essences give [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Soulium Dust].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust] Seed: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Soulium Dust] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_essence|Imperium Essence], [hl|tier 4].
[li] The trips to the Nether can stop.

es_es.title: Soulium sembrado
text: [lead] [b|8] esencias dan [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Polvos de soulium].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Polvos de soulium] y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_essence|Esencias de imperium], [hl|nivel 4].
[li] Se terminan los viajes al Nether.

en_us.title: Soulstone masonry
text: [lead] Soulstone works like any stone.
[li] Bricks, chiseled bricks, smooth, slabs, stairs and walls.
[li] Most of them in one step at a stonecutter.
[li] It also builds the awakening altar, its pedestals and its vessels.

es_es.title: Mampostería de alma
text: [lead] La piedra de alma se trabaja como cualquier piedra.
[li] Ladrillos, ladrillos cincelados, lisa, losas, escaleras y muros.
[li] Casi todo de un paso en el cortapiedras.
[li] También arma el altar del despertar, sus pedestales y sus recipientes.

en_us.title: Soulium for the common store
en_us.subtitle: Every jar starts with a pinch.
text: [lead] Sixteen [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Soulium Dust] for the common store.
[li] Jars, daggers and mob seed bases all start with a pinch of it.

es_es.title: Soulium para el depósito común
es_es.subtitle: Todo tarro arranca con una pizca.
text: [lead] Dieciséis [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_dust|Polvos de soulium] para el depósito común.
[li] Tarros, dagas y bases de semillas de mob arrancan con una pizca.

en_us.title: Five percent
en_us.subtitle: Found one. Staring is allowed.
text: [lead] One soulstone block in [b|20] is [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ore|Soulium Ore], and you found one.
[li] Fortune raises its [b|1] to [b|3] dust.

es_es.title: Cinco por ciento
es_es.subtitle: Encontraste una. Mirar está permitido.
text: [lead] Uno de cada [b|20] bloques de piedra de alma es [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_ore|Mena de soulium], y encontraste uno.
[li] Fortuna sube sus [b|1] a [b|3] polvos.

en_us.title: Pig
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|6] [item:minecraft:porkchop|Raw Porkchops].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|8] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a pig.

es_es.title: Cerdo
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|6] [item:minecraft:porkchop|Chuletas de cerdo crudas].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|8] almas.
{page}
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en un cerdo.

en_us.title: Chicken
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|8] [item:minecraft:egg|Eggs], [b|8] feathers or [b|6] raw chicken.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|8] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a chicken.

es_es.title: Pollo
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|8] [item:minecraft:egg|Huevos], [b|8] plumas o [b|6] pollos crudos.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|8] almas.
{page}
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en un pollo.

en_us.title: Cow
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|6] [item:minecraft:leather|Leather] or [b|6] raw beef.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|8] souls.
{page}
[li:minecraft:milk_bucket] Four and a bucket give a [item:minecraft:milk_bucket|Milk Bucket].
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a cow.

es_es.title: Vaca
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|6] de [item:minecraft:leather|Cuero] o [b|6] filetes crudos.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|8] almas.
{page}
[li:minecraft:milk_bucket] Cuatro y un cubo dan un [item:minecraft:milk_bucket|Cubo con leche].
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en una vaca.

en_us.title: Sheep
en_us.subtitle: Shearing, skipped.
text: [lead] [b|8] essences give [b|6] [item:minecraft:white_wool|White Wool]; three give [b|6] raw mutton.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|8] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a sheep.

es_es.title: Oveja
es_es.subtitle: Sin tijeras.
text: [lead] [b|8] esencias dan [b|6] de [item:minecraft:white_wool|Lana blanca]; tres dan [b|6] de cordero crudo.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|8] almas.
{page}
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en una oveja.

en_us.title: The barnyard
en_us.subtitle: The whole farm, in seeds.
text: [lead] Pig, chicken, cow and sheep.
[li] Harvest [b|16] essences from any of its crops.
[li] Then pick a bonus: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_growth_accelerator|Prudentium Growth Accelerators], two Soul Jars or essence.

es_es.title: El corral
es_es.subtitle: La granja entera, en semillas.
text: [lead] Cerdo, pollo, vaca y oveja.
[li] Cosechá [b|16] esencias de cualquiera de sus cultivos.
[li] Después elegí un premio: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_growth_accelerator|Aceleradores de crecimiento de prudentium], tarros de alma o esencia.

en_us.title: Squid
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|6] [item:minecraft:ink_sac|Ink Sacs] or [b|4] glow ink sacs.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|6] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a squid.

es_es.title: Calamar
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|6] [item:minecraft:ink_sac|Sacos de tinta] o [b|4] sacos de tinta luminosa.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|6] almas.
{page}
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en un calamar.

en_us.title: Fish
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|6] [item:minecraft:cod|Raw Cod], salmon or tropical fish.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|6] souls: cod, salmon, tropical fish and pufferfish all count.
{page}
[li] Eight give [b|6] pufferfish.
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a fish.

es_es.title: Pescado
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|6] [item:minecraft:cod|Bacalaos crudos], salmones o peces tropicales.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|6] almas: cuentan el bacalao, el salmón, el pez tropical y el pez globo.
{page}
[li] Ocho dan [b|6] peces globo.
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en un pez.

en_us.title: Turtle
en_us.subtitle: Shells, no babysitting.
text: [lead] [b|8] essences give [b|4] [item:minecraft:turtle_scute|Turtle Scutes].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|6] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a turtle.

es_es.title: Tortuga
es_es.subtitle: Caparazones sin cuidar huevos.
text: [lead] [b|8] esencias dan [b|4] [item:minecraft:turtle_scute|Escamas de tortuga].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|6] almas.
{page}
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en una tortuga.

en_us.title: Things that swim
text: [lead] Squid, fish and turtle.
[li] Harvest [b|16] essences from any of its crops.
[li] Then pick a bonus: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_growth_accelerator|Prudentium Growth Accelerators], two Soul Jars or essence.

es_es.title: Lo que nada
text: [lead] Calamar, pez y tortuga.
[li] Cosechá [b|16] esencias de cualquiera de sus cultivos.
[li] Después elegí un premio: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_growth_accelerator|Aceleradores de crecimiento de prudentium], tarros de alma o esencia.

en_us.title: Slime
en_us.subtitle: The hungriest jar in the mod.
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|8] [item:minecraft:slime_ball|Slimeballs].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence], [hl|tier 2].
[li] One jar holds [b|12] souls.
{page}
[li:minecraft:magma_cream] Four with one blaze essence give [b|6] [item:minecraft:magma_cream|Magma Cream].
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|12] essences back into a slime.

es_es.title: Slime
es_es.subtitle: El tarro más glotón del mod.
text: [lead] [b|3] esencias dan [b|8] [item:minecraft:slime_ball|Bolas de slime].
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Tarros de alma] llenos y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium], [hl|nivel 2].
[li] Cada tarro guarda [b|12] almas.
{page}
[li:minecraft:magma_cream] Cuatro con una de blaze dan [b|6] de [item:minecraft:magma_cream|Crema de magma].
[li] El [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Generador de soulium] convierte [b|12] esencias en un slime.

en_us.title: Rabbit
text: [lead] [b|3] essences give [b|3] [item:minecraft:rabbit_foot|Rabbit's Feet], [b|8] hides or [b|6] raw rabbit.
[li:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar] Seed: [b|4] full [item:mysticalagriculture:soul_jar|Soul Jars] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_essence|Tertium Essence], [hl|tier 3].
[li] One jar holds [b|6] souls.
{page}
[li] A [item:mysticalagriculture:soulium_spawner|Soulium Spawner] turns [b|16] essences back into a rabbit.

es_es.title: Conejo

[li] The Enchanter drinks their essence, and Mystical Enlightenment needs it.
{page}
[li:mysticalagriculture:experience_droplet] Eight essences give [b|8] [item:mysticalagriculture:experience_droplet|Experience Droplets].
[li:minecraft:experience_bottle] Each droplet and a glass bottle make a [item:minecraft:experience_bottle|Bottle o' Enchanting].

es_es.title: Experiencia embotellada y sembrada
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:experience_capsule|Cápsula de experiencia] absorbe los orbes que juntes, hasta [b|1200] puntos.
[li] Receta: [b|2] lingotes de soulium y [b|2] cristales de alma.
[li] Cuatro llenas en los pedestales dan [item:mysticalagriculture:experience_seeds|Semillas de experiencia], [hl|nivel 4].
[li] El Encantador toma su esencia, y la Iluminación mística la necesita.
{page}
[li:mysticalagriculture:experience_droplet] Ocho esencias dan [b|8] [item:mysticalagriculture:experience_droplet|Gotas de experiencia].
[li:minecraft:experience_bottle] Cada gota con un frasco de cristal da un [item:minecraft:experience_bottle|Frasco con experiencia].

en_us.title: Mending, on request
text: [tip] The Enchanter does Mending too: [b|3] wither skeleton skulls and [b|256] experience essence.
[li] Silk Touch: [b|32] slimeballs and [b|128] essence.

es_es.title: Reparación, a pedido
text: [tip] El Encantador también hace Reparación: [b|3] calaveras de esqueleto del Wither y [b|256] esencias de experiencia.
[li] Toque de seda: [b|32] bolas de slime y [b|128] esencias.

en_us.title: Room for one more ability
text: [lead] Augments add abilities to essence gear.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:tinkering_table|Tinkering Table]: stone and [b|2] soulium dust.
[li:mysticalagriculture:unattuned_augment] [item:mysticalagriculture:unattuned_augment|Unattuned Augment]: prosperity shards and iron.
[li] Infuse the augment on the altar, then socket it at the table.

es_es.title: Lugar para una habilidad más
text: [lead] Los aumentos le suman habilidades al equipo de esencia.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:tinkering_table|Mesa de modificaciones]: piedra y [b|2] polvos de soulium.
[li:mysticalagriculture:unattuned_augment] [item:mysticalagriculture:unattuned_augment|Aumento no sintonizado]: fragmentos de prosperidad y hierro.
[li] Infundí el aumento en el altar y después encastralo desde la mesa.

en_us.title: Inferium gear
text: [lead] Diamond gear plus [b|2] ingots and [b|2] gemstones of a tier becomes that tier's gear.
[li] It keeps its enchantments.
[li] It lasts longer, digs faster and has one augment slot.
[li] An anvil repairs it with the tier's ingot.

es_es.title: Equipo de inferium
text: [lead] El equipo de diamante más [b|2] lingotes y [b|2] gemas de un nivel se vuelve el equipo de ese nivel.
[li] Conserva sus encantamientos.
[li] Dura más, rompe más rápido y tiene un espacio de aumento.
[li] El yunque lo repara con el lingote del nivel.

en_us.title: Prudentium gear
text: [lead] Each tier upgrades the last one's piece: the pickaxe you started with keeps climbing.
[li] Tier [hl|2] opens Speed I, Night Vision, Jump Boost I and Mining AOE I.

es_es.title: Equipo de prudentium
text: [lead] Cada nivel mejora la pieza del anterior: el pico con el que empezaste sigue subiendo.
[li] El nivel [hl|2] abre velocidad I, visión nocturna, salto aumentado I y ADE de minería I.

en_us.title: Tertium gear
text: [lead] Tertium gear takes the augments that change how you move.
[li] Step Assist, No Fall Damage, Slow Falling and Fire Resistance.
[li] Haste I and Strength I as well.

es_es.title: Equipo de tertium
text: [lead] El equipo de tertium acepta los aumentos que cambian cómo te movés.
[li] Asistencia de paso, sin daño de caída, caída lenta y resistencia al fuego.
[li] También prisa I y fuerza I.

en_us.title: Imperium gear
text: [lead] Imperium gear carries the tier-[hl|4] augments.
[li] Haste II, Speed III and Strength II.
[li] Poison Resistance, Hunger Resistance and Mining AOE III.

es_es.title: Equipo de imperium
text: [lead] El equipo de imperium lleva los aumentos de nivel [hl|4].
[li] Prisa II, velocidad III y fuerza II.
[li] Resistencia al veneno, resistencia al hambre y ADE de minería III.

en_us.title: Supremium gear
text: [lead] Supremium gear takes every augment, flight included.
[li] Its tools enchant at a plain enchanting table.
[li] The armor still wears out: the pack keeps that default.

es_es.title: Equipo de supremium
text: [lead] El equipo de supremium acepta todos los aumentos, vuelo incluido.
[li] Sus herramientas se encantan en una mesa común.
[li] La armadura igual se gasta: el pack deja ese valor por defecto.

en_us.title: Creative flight, earned
en_us.subtitle: Four nether stars. Worth every one.
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:flight_augment|Flight Augment] grants creative flight while you wear it.
[li] Infused from [b|4] nether stars and [b|4] supremium essences.
[li] It goes in a supremium chestplate.

es_es.title: Vuelo creativo, ganado
es_es.subtitle: Cuatro estrellas del Nether. Valen cada una.
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:flight_augment|Aumento de vuelo] da vuelo creativo mientras lo tengas puesto.
[li] Se infunde con [b|4] estrellas del Nether y [b|4] esencias de supremium.
[li] Va en un peto de supremium.

en_us.title: Bows, rods and shears
text: [lead] The same upgrade works on bows, crossbows, fishing rods and shears.
[li] Essence bows and crossbows draw faster and hit harder with each tier.
[li] From [b|1.1×] speed and [b|+1] damage at inferium to [b|2.1×] and [b|+4] awakened.

es_es.title: Arcos, cañas y tijeras
text: [lead] La misma mejora sirve para arcos, ballestas, cañas de pescar y tijeras.
[li] Los arcos y ballestas de esencia tensan más rápido y pegan más fuerte con cada nivel.
[li] De [b|1,1×] de velocidad y [b|+1] de daño en inferium a [b|2,1×] y [b|+4] despertados.

en_us.title: Augments for digging
text: [lead] Area augments dig, till and make paths in [b|3×3], up to [b|9×9] at their top tier.
[li] Iron tools around an unattuned augment make them.
[li] Haste goes on a chestplate and costs redstone.

es_es.title: Aumentos para cavar
text: [lead] Los aumentos de área cavan, aran y hacen caminos en [b|3×3], hasta [b|9×9] en su último nivel.
[li] Herramientas de hierro alrededor de un aumento no sintonizado los hacen.
[li] La prisa va en el peto y cuesta redstone.

en_us.title: Augments for the senses
text: [lead] Three augments for what you see and breathe.
[li] Golden carrots: Night Vision, on helmets.
[li] Pufferfish: Water Breathing, on helmets.
[li] Magma cream: Fire Resistance, on any armor piece.

es_es.title: Aumentos para los sentidos
text: [lead] Tres aumentos para lo que ves y respirás.
[li] Zanahorias doradas: visión nocturna, en el casco.
[li] Peces globo: respiración acuática, en el casco.
[li] Crema de magma: resistencia al fuego, en cualquier pieza.

en_us.title: Augments for the road
text: [lead] Four augments for getting around.
[li] Sugar: Speed, on leggings.
[li] Rabbit's feet: Jump Boost; diamonds and wool: No Fall Damage. Both on boots.
[li] Stairs: Step Assist, on leggings or boots.

es_es.title: Aumentos para el camino
text: [lead] Cuatro aumentos para moverte.
[li] Azúcar: velocidad, en los pantalones.
[li] Patas de conejo: salto; diamantes y lana: sin daño de caída. Los dos en las botas.
[li] Escaleras: asistencia de paso, en pantalones o botas.

en_us.title: Augments for a fight
text: [lead] Swords and armor get their own augments.
[li] Strength and Attack AOE go on swords.
[li] Health Boost and Absorption go on any armor: up to [b|10] extra hearts.
[li] Health Boost costs wither skeleton skulls from level I.

es_es.title: Aumentos para pelear
text: [lead] Las espadas y la armadura tienen sus propios aumentos.
[li] Fuerza y ADE de ataque van en espadas.
[li] Mejora de salud y absorción, en cualquier armadura: hasta [b|10] corazones extra.
[li] La mejora de salud pide calaveras de esqueleto del Wither desde el nivel I.

en_us.title: Augments against bad luck
text: [lead] One resistance per augment.
[li] Leather and milk: Nausea. Torches and glowstone: Blindness.
[li] Milk and imperium: Poison.
[li] Wither Resistance is tier [hl|5]: [b|2] nether stars, [b|2] wither skeleton skulls and [b|4] supremium.

es_es.title: Aumentos contra la mala suerte
text: [lead] Una resistencia por aumento.
[li] Cuero y leche: náuseas. Antorchas y piedra luminosa: ceguera.
[li] Leche e imperium: veneno.
[li] La resistencia al Wither es de nivel [hl|5]: [b|2] estrellas del Nether, [b|2] calaveras de esqueleto del Wither y [b|4] supremium.

en_us.title: The second altar
en_us.subtitle: Orange wool this time. It matters.
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:awakening_altar|Awakening Altar] wakes supremium up.
[li] Gold, orange wool and soulstone make it and its [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:awakening_pedestal|Awakening Pedestals].
[li] Placed, it shows the eight spots: four pedestals and four vessels.
[li] A redstone signal starts it.

es_es.title: El segundo altar
es_es.subtitle: Esta vez con lana naranja. Importa.
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:awakening_altar|Altar del despertar] despierta al supremium.
[li] Oro, lana naranja y piedra de alma hacen el altar y sus [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:awakening_pedestal|Pedestales del despertar].
[li] Al colocarlo muestra los ocho lugares: cuatro pedestales y cuatro recipientes.
[li] Lo arranca una señal de redstone.

en_us.title: Air
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:air_essence|Air Essence] fills a vessel of the awakening altar.
[li] Seed: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:air_agglomeratio|Air Agglomeratio] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence], [hl|elemental tier].
[li] Each agglomeratio: a glass bottle, gravel, dirt and a clay ball.

es_es.title: Aire
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:air_essence|Esencia de aire] llena un recipiente del altar del despertar.
[li] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:air_agglomeratio|Aglomeraciones de aire] y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencias de inferium], [hl|nivel elemental].
[li] Cada aglomeración: un frasco de cristal, grava, tierra y una bola de arcilla.

en_us.title: Earth
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:earth_essence|Earth Essence] fills a vessel of the awakening altar.
[li] Seed: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:earth_agglomeratio|Earth Agglomeratio] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence], [hl|elemental tier].
[li] Each agglomeratio: short grass, gravel, dirt and a clay ball.
{page}
[li] One earth with eight nether essences gives [b|16] soul soil.

es_es.title: Tierra
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:earth_essence|Esencia de tierra] llena un recipiente del altar del despertar.
[li] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:earth_agglomeratio|Aglomeraciones de tierra] y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencias de inferium], [hl|nivel elemental].
[li] Cada aglomeración: hierba, grava, tierra y una bola de arcilla.
{page}
[li] Una de tierra con ocho del Nether da [b|16] de tierra de almas.

en_us.title: Water
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:water_essence|Water Essence] fills a vessel; four in a bucket make a [item:minecraft:water_bucket|Water Bucket].
[li] Seed: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:water_agglomeratio|Water Agglomeratio] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence], [hl|elemental tier].
[li] Each agglomeratio: a water bucket, gravel, dirt and a clay ball.
{page}
[li] One essence sets eight concrete powder into [b|8] concrete.
[li] With dirt: [b|24] clay balls or [b|12] mud. With nature: [b|8] kelp.

es_es.title: Agua
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:water_essence|Esencia de agua] llena un recipiente; cuatro con un cubo dan un [item:minecraft:water_bucket|Cubo con agua].
[li] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:water_agglomeratio|Aglomeraciones de agua] y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencias de inferium], [hl|nivel elemental].
[li] Cada aglomeración: un cubo de agua, grava, tierra y una bola de arcilla.
{page}
[li] Una esencia fragua ocho de cemento en polvo en [b|8] de hormigón.
[li] Con tierra: [b|24] bolas de arcilla o [b|12] de barro. Con naturaleza: [b|8] algas.

en_us.title: Fire
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:fire_essence|Fire Essence] fills a vessel; four in a bucket make a [item:minecraft:lava_bucket|Lava Bucket].
[li] Seed: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:fire_agglomeratio|Fire Agglomeratio] and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence], [hl|elemental tier].
[li] Each agglomeratio: a lava bucket, gravel, dirt and a clay ball.
{page}
[li] With dirt: [b|16] sand or red sand. With stone: [b|8] flint or [b|12] tuff.

es_es.title: Fuego
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:fire_essence|Esencia de fuego] llena un recipiente; cuatro con un cubo dan un [item:minecraft:lava_bucket|Cubo con lava].
[li] Semilla: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:fire_agglomeratio|Aglomeraciones de fuego] y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencias de inferium], [hl|nivel elemental].
[li] Cada aglomeración: un cubo de lava, grava, tierra y una bola de arcilla.
{page}
[li] Con tierra: [b|16] de arena o arena roja. Con piedra: [b|8] pedernales o [b|12] de toba.

en_us.title: The four elements
en_us.subtitle: Gravel, dirt and clay, four ways.
text: [lead] Each awakening drinks [b|10] of every element.
[li] Air, earth, water and fire essence, ten of each.
{page}
[tip] Elemental crops count inferium farmland as their own tier: plant them there for the [b|20%] odds.

es_es.title: Los cuatro elementos
es_es.subtitle: Grava, tierra y arcilla, de cuatro maneras.
text: [lead] Cada despertar toma [b|10] de cada elemento.
[li] Esencia de aire, tierra, agua y fuego, diez de cada una.
{page}
[tip] Los cultivos elementales toman la tierra de inferium como la de su nivel: plantalos ahí para tener el [b|20%].

en_us.title: Four vessels
text: [lead] Each [item:mysticalagriculture:essence_vessel|Essence Vessel] holds up to [b|40] of one elemental essence.
[li] Recipe: gold, glass and soulstone.
[li] The awakening altar drinks from all four at once.

es_es.title: Cuatro recipientes
text: [lead] Cada [item:mysticalagriculture:essence_vessel|Recipiente de esencia] guarda hasta [b|40] de una sola esencia elemental.
[li] Receta: oro, cristal y piedra de alma.
[li] El altar del despertar toma de los cuatro a la vez.

en_us.title: The Wither
en_us.subtitle: A donor with three heads.
text: [lead] Killed with an essence weapon enchanted with Mystical Enlightenment, it drops [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Cognizant Dust].
[li] [b|4] at level I, one more per level.
[li] Any essence weapon also shakes out [b|1] to [b|3] essences of its tier.
{page}
[tip] Mystical Enlightenment comes from the Enchanter: [b|3] supremium and [b|64] experience essences per level.

es_es.title: El Wither
es_es.subtitle: Un donante de tres cabezas.
text: [lead] Si lo matás con un arma de esencia encantada con Iluminación mística, suelta [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Polvo cognizante].
[li] [b|4] con nivel I y uno más por nivel.
[li] Cualquier arma de esencia además le saca [b|1] a [b|3] esencias de su nivel.
{page}
[tip] La Iluminación mística sale del Encantador: [b|3] esencias de supremium y [b|64] de experiencia por nivel.

en_us.title: The Ender Dragon
en_us.subtitle: Better odds, longer commute.
text: [lead] The Dragon pays more: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Cognizant Dust] plus [b|2] per Mystical Enlightenment level.
[li] And [b|2] to [b|4] essences of your weapon's tier.

es_es.title: El Dragón del End
es_es.subtitle: Mejores números, viaje más largo.
text: [lead] El Dragón paga mejor: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Polvos cognizantes] más [b|2] por nivel de Iluminación mística.
[li] Y [b|2] a [b|4] esencias del nivel de tu arma.

en_us.title: Dust that knows
text: [lead] One awakening takes [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Cognizant Dust], a supremium block and [b|10] of each element.
[li] The dust goes on the four pedestals.
[li] The block on the altar, the elements in the vessels.

es_es.title: Polvo que sabe
text: [lead] Un despertar pide [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:cognizant_dust|Polvos cognizantes], un bloque de supremium y [b|10] de cada elemento.
[li] El polvo va en los cuatro pedestales.
[li] El bloque en el altar, los elementos en los recipientes.

en_us.title: Awake
en_us.subtitle: The block that got a promotion.
text: [lead] The altar turns a supremium block into an [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_block|Awakened Supremium Block].
[li:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_essence] It breaks into [b|9] [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_essence|Awakened Supremium Essence].
[li] Two per prosperity ingot or gemstone make the awakened metal.

es_es.title: Despierto
es_es.subtitle: El bloque que ascendió.
text: [lead] El altar vuelve un bloque de supremium un [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_block|Bloque de supremium despertado].
[li:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_essence] Se parte en [b|9] [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_essence|Esencias de supremium despertado].
[li] Dos por lingote o gema de prosperidad hacen el metal despertado.

en_us.title: Awakened gear
text: [lead] Awakened gear has two augment slots.
[li] Supremium gear on the awakening altar, awakened ingots and gemstones on the pedestals.
[li] [b|40] of each element in the vessels.
[li] The awakened can waters [b|13×13] at even odds.

es_es.title: Equipo despertado
text: [lead] El equipo despertado tiene dos espacios de aumento.
[li] El equipo de supremium en el altar del despertar; lingotes y gemas despertados en los pedestales.
[li] [b|40] de cada elemento en los recipientes.
[li] La regadera despertada riega [b|13×13] con chance pareja.

en_us.title: A full awakened set
en_us.subtitle: Walk through the field. It grows.
text: [lead] Wear all four awakened pieces for the set bonus: plants grow faster around you.
[li] Each piece keeps its own two augment slots.

es_es.title: Un juego despertado completo
es_es.subtitle: Caminá por el campo. Crece.
text: [lead] Con las cuatro piezas despertadas puestas tenés el bono de conjunto: las plantas crecen más rápido a tu alrededor.
[li] Cada pieza conserva sus dos espacios de aumento.

en_us.title: The last accelerator
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_growth_accelerator|Awakened Supremium Growth Accelerators] reach [b|54] blocks.
[li] [b|4] awakened essences, stone and an awakened gemstone make [b|3].
[li] On the awakening altar, [b|20] of each element turn a supremium upgrade into the top one.

es_es.title: El último acelerador
text: [lead] Los [item:mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_growth_accelerator|Aceleradores de crecimiento de supremium despertado] llegan a [b|54] bloques.
[li] [b|4] esencias despertadas, piedra y una gema despertada dan [b|3].
[li] En el altar del despertar, [b|20] de cada elemento vuelven la mejora de supremium la mejor de todas.

en_us.title: Forty to the brim
text: [tip] Keep the vessels full.
[li] A block takes [b|10] of each element.
[li] Each awakened tool or armor piece, [b|40]; the top machine upgrade, [b|20].

es_es.title: Cuarenta hasta el borde
text: [tip] Mantené los recipientes llenos.
[li] Un bloque pide [b|10] de cada elemento.
[li] Cada herramienta o pieza despertada, [b|40]; la mejor mejora de máquina, [b|20].

en_us.title: Pick your boss
text: [tip] Mystical Enlightenment V costs [b|15] supremium and [b|320] experience essence.
[li] With it the Dragon drops [b|14] dust and the Wither [b|8].

es_es.title: Elegí tu jefe
text: [tip] La Iluminación mística V cuesta [b|15] supremium y [b|320] esencias de experiencia.
[li] Con ella el Dragón suelta [b|14] polvos y el Wither, [b|8].

en_us.title: Light the soul lantern
en_us.subtitle: Some guests only come at night.
text: [lead] One blue flame and the hilltop fills with company.
Nothing to build. Mind the draught.

es_es.title: Prendé el farol de almas
es_es.subtitle: Algunos invitados sólo vienen de noche.
text: [lead] Una llama azul y la cima se llena de compañía.
Nada que fabricar. Ojo con la corriente.

en_us.title: Three tools in one
en_us.subtitle: The Swiss army knife that never wears out.
text: [lead] A pickaxe, an axe and a shovel of one tier, plus [b|2] rods, make one [item:mysticalagradditions:inferium_paxel|Paxel].
[li] It never wears out and takes the augments of its three tools: one slot, two when awakened.
{page}
[li] Every tier has its paxel, from inferium to supremium.
[li] The awakening altar takes a supremium paxel, [b|2] awakened gemstones and [b|2] awakened ingots, with [b|40] of each element in the vessels.

es_es.title: Tres herramientas en una
es_es.subtitle: La navaja suiza que no se gasta.
text: [lead] Un pico, un hacha y una pala de un mismo nivel, más [b|2] palos, hacen una [item:mysticalagradditions:inferium_paxel|Multi-herramienta].
[li] No se gasta y toma los aumentos de sus tres herramientas: un espacio, dos si está despertada.
{page}
[li] Cada nivel tiene la suya, de inferium a supremium.
[li] El altar del despertar pide una multi-herramienta de supremium, [b|2] gemas y [b|2] lingotes despertados, con [b|40] de cada elemento en los recipientes.
